definition_en: Flux-cored arc welding in which the core ingredients alone provide shielding of the arc and weld pool, so no external shielding gas is supplied; ISO 4063 process 114.
term_ja: セルフシールドアーク溶接
variants_ja: ノンガスシールドアーク溶接
term_zh: 自保护药芯焊丝电弧焊
term_ko: 셀프 실드 플럭스 코어드 아크 용접
term_es: soldadura por arco con alambre tubular autoprotegido
source_ref: ISO 4063 Welding, brazing, soldering and cutting — Nomenclature of processes and reference numbers

definition_en: Hole formed through the full thickness of the workpiece at the leading edge of the weld pool by a concentrated plasma arc or beam; molten metal flows around it and closes behind it, giving full penetration.
ng_note: 「鍵穴」（日本語）は錠前の鍵穴を指す日常語で、溶接では使わない（キーホール）。
source_ref: AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

definition_en: Planned overlap of each new weld bead on the previous one in cladding, surfacing or multipass layers, usually expressed as a percentage of bead width, to obtain a smooth surface and uniform dilution.
ng_note: 「焊瘤」（中国語）、「Schweißgutüberlauf」（ドイツ語）は溶接欠陥のオーバラップ（溶融金属が止端で母材にかぶさった不完全部）で、隣接ビードの計画的な重なりを指さない。
source_ref: Norrish, Advanced Welding Processes, Woodhead Publishing

definition_en: Welding power source that rectifies the mains supply, switches it at high frequency through semiconductor devices into a small transformer and rectifies it again, giving a compact, light unit with fast output control.
term_ja: インバータ式アーク溶接電源
variants_ja: インバータ溶接電源;インバータ溶接機
source_ref: IEC 60974-1 Arc welding equipment — Part 1: Welding power sources

definition_en: Iron-cored inductor in the output circuit of a welding power source that smooths the current and limits the rate of current change, notably during short-circuit metal transfer.
ng_note: 「反応器」「原子炉」（中国語「反应器」「反应堆」、韓国語「반응기」「원자로」、ドイツ語 Reaktor）は化学反応装置・原子炉の語で、溶接電源の電流平滑用インダクタにはならない。
source_ref: Lincoln Electric, The Procedure Handbook of Arc Welding, 14th ed.

definition_en: Free length of wire electrode between the end of the contact tip and the arc in wire-fed processes (or of a tungsten electrode beyond the gas cup in GTAW), which affects resistive preheating of the wire and arc stability.
variants_ja: ワイヤ突出し長さ;スティックアウト長さ;エクステンション
ng_note: 日本語「電極延長」は electrode extension の直訳で、コンタクトチップ先端から突き出たワイヤの長さ（突出し長さ）の意味にならない。
source_ref: AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

definition_en: In resistance welding, the interval without welding current between successive current impulses of a pulsation or multi-impulse schedule, while the electrode force is kept.
source_ref: ISO 17677-1 (Resistance welding — Vocabulary — Part 1: Spot, projection and seam welding); JIS Z 3001-6:2013 4.4.1

definition_en: Combination of sheets placed between the electrodes for a resistance spot weld, described by the number, thicknesses, grades and coatings of the sheets, on which the welding schedule is based.
ng_note: 「堆栈」は中国語でソフトウェアのスタック（データ構造）を指し、スポット溶接の板組みには使わない。
source_ref: AWS D8.1M Specification for Automotive Weld Quality — Resistance Spot Welding of Steel

definition_en: Steel sheet hot-dip galvanized and then heated so that the zinc coating alloys with iron, giving a Zn-Fe coating whose higher contact resistance and harder coating influence spot weldability and electrode life.
term_ja: 合金化溶融亜鉛めっき鋼板
ng_note: 「ガルバリウム鋼板」は55%アルミニウム-亜鉛合金めっき鋼板の呼び名（商標）で、亜鉛-鉄合金めっきの合金化溶融亜鉛めっき鋼板とは別の製品。
source_ref: ISO 14373 (Resistance welding — Procedure for spot welding of uncoated and coated low carbon steels)

definition_en: Electron beam welding carried out with the workpiece inside an evacuated chamber, which avoids beam scattering and gives deep, narrow welds; ISO 4063 process 511.
term_es: soldeo por haz de electrones en vacío
source_ref: ISO 4063 Welding, brazing, soldering and cutting — Nomenclature of processes and reference numbers; JIS Z 3001-2:2018 Welding and allied processes — Vocabulary — Part 2: Welding processes

definition_en: Solid-state laser whose gain medium is an optical fiber doped with a rare-earth element, usually ytterbium, pumped by laser diodes and emitting near 1.07 µm, widely used for welding and cutting.
variants_ja: ファイバーレーザー;ファイバレーザ
ng_note: 「繊維レーザ」（日本語）・「纤维激光器」（中国語）は fiber を織物の繊維と取り違えた直訳で、光ファイバを利得媒質とするレーザには使わない。
source_ref: JIS Z 3001-5:2013 溶接用語－第5部：レーザ溶接; IPG Photonics: fiber laser welding (public technical pages)

definition_en: For a pulsed or modulated laser, the ratio of the pulse duration to the pulse period, usually given in percent.
ng_note: 「使用率」（日本語）、「负载持续率」（中国語）、「사용률」（韓国語）、「Einschaltdauer」（ドイツ語）、「factor de marcha」（スペイン語）は溶接電源の定格使用率（10 分周期で出力できる時間の割合）を表し、レーザのパルスのオン時間比にはならない。
source_ref: ISO 11145 (Optics and photonics — Lasers and laser-related equipment — Vocabulary and symbols); JIS Z 3001-5:2013

definition_en: Solid-state welding process in which high-frequency vibration applied parallel to the faying surfaces under moderate pressure breaks up surface oxides and bonds overlapping metal parts without melting them.
variants_ja: 超音波接合;超音波圧接
source_ref: ISO 4063:2009 Welding and allied processes — Nomenclature of processes and reference numbers

definition_en: Solid-state welding in which the parts are heated in a forge or furnace and joined by hammering, pressing or rolling, historically the first welding process and still used for forge-welded pipe.
ng_note: 「鍛造」「锻造」（中国語）「단조」（韓国語）「Schmieden」（ドイツ語）「forjado」（スペイン語）は接合を伴わない鍛造加工を指し、加熱した部材を打撃・加圧して接合する鍛接とは別概念。
source_ref: AWS A3.0M/A3.0 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

definition_en: Steel plate covered over its whole surface by a layer of another metal, such as stainless steel, nickel alloy or titanium, metallurgically bonded by roll bonding, explosion welding or weld overlay.
ng_note: 「めっき鋼板」（日本語）、「镀层钢板」（中国語）はめっきで表面処理した鋼板で、合わせ材を金属学的に接合したクラッド鋼板とは別物。
source_ref: ASTM A264 Standard Specification for Stainless Chromium-Nickel Steel-Clad Plate

definition_en: Joint between two parts made of different metals or alloy systems, for example steel to aluminum or ferritic to austenitic steel, made by welding, brazing or another joining method.
source_ref: K. Martinsen, S.J. Hu, B.E. Carlson, Joining of dissimilar materials, CIRP Annals 64(2) (2015) 679–699; ISO 15614-1:2017 Specification and qualification of welding procedures for metallic materials — Welding procedure test — Part 1: Arc and gas welding of steels and arc welding of nickel and nickel alloys

definition_en: Soldering in which the joint is heated with a fuel gas flame from a hand-held or mechanized torch, as in plumbing joints of copper tube.
source_ref: AWS A3.0M/A3.0 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

definition_en: Concave meniscus of brazing filler metal that forms at the edges of a brazed joint where the filler leaves the capillary gap.
ng_note: 日本語の「すみ肉」、中国語の「角焊缝」、韓国語の「필릿 용접」、ドイツ語の「Kehlnaht」はすみ肉溶接（fillet weld）を指す語で、ろう付継手の端にできるろうのフィレットには使わない。
source_ref: ISO 857-2:2005 Welding and allied processes — Vocabulary — Part 2: Soldering and brazing processes and related terms; JIS Z 3001-3 Welding and allied processes — Vocabulary — Part 3: Soldering and brazing

definition_en: Oxy-fuel gas flame with more fuel gas than needed for complete combustion, recognized by a feather around the inner cone, used for some brazing and hardfacing.
ng_note: 「浸炭炎」（日本語）・「渗碳焰」（中国語）は熱処理の浸炭（carburizing）から作った直訳で、燃料ガス過剰の炎の名称には使わない。
source_ref: AWS C3.4M/C3.4 Specification for Torch Brazing; JIS Z 3001-1:2018 4.7.3; AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

definition_en: Chemical cleaning of stainless steel welds and fabrications in an acid solution or paste, typically nitric-hydrofluoric acid, to remove heat tint, scale and the chromium-depleted layer beneath it.
ng_note: スペイン語の「encurtido」は食品の酢漬けを指す辞書訳で、金属の酸洗いには使わない。
source_ref: ASTM A380/A380M Standard Practice for Cleaning, Descaling, and Passivation of Stainless Steel Parts, Equipment, and Systems

definition_en: Time the preheat flame is held on the starting point in oxyfuel cutting until the steel reaches its ignition temperature, before the cutting oxygen is turned on.
source_ref: ESAB cutting systems and consumables — public catalogues and manuals

definition_en: Venturi nozzle in an injector-type gas torch in which the high-velocity oxygen jet draws in fuel gas supplied at low pressure and mixes with it before the flame.
ng_note: 「燃料噴射弁」「喷油器」（中国語）「Einspritzdüse」（ドイツ語）はエンジンの燃料噴射装置を指し、低圧式吹管で酸素噴流により燃料ガスを吸引混合するインゼクタとは別物。
source_ref: ISO 5172 Gas welding equipment — Blowpipes for gas welding, heating and cutting — Specifications and tests

definition_en: Removal of surface defects such as cracks and seams from steel slabs, blooms or billets by a wide oxygen-fuel flame that burns away a thin surface layer, by hand or with a scarfing machine.
ng_note: 「スカーフ継手」（日本語）、「斜接接头」（中国語）、「Schäftung」（ドイツ語）は端部を斜めに削いで重ねる継手（scarf joint）を指し、鋼片表面を酸素炎で除去する作業にはならない。
source_ref: AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

definition_en: Covered electrode for manual metal arc welding of creep-resisting low-alloy steels such as Mo, Cr-Mo and Cr-Mo-V grades used at elevated temperature, classified in ISO 3580.
term_ja: モリブデン鋼及びクロムモリブデン鋼用被覆アーク溶接棒
variants_ja: 低合金耐熱鋼用被覆アーク溶接棒
term_es: electrodo revestido para aceros resistentes a la fluencia
source_ref: ISO 3580 Welding consumables — Covered electrodes for manual metal arc welding of creep-resisting steels — Classification

definition_en: Electrode covering based mainly on limestone (calcium carbonate) and fluorspar, coded B in ISO 2560-A, which gives a low-hydrogen weld metal with good toughness and crack resistance.
ng_note: 「基本被覆」（中国語「基本药皮」、韓国語「기본 피복」）は basic を「基本の」と訳した直訳。ここでの basic は化学の塩基性（石灰石・ほたる石系）を表す。
source_ref: ISO 2560 Welding consumables — Covered electrodes for manual metal arc welding of non-alloy and fine grain steels — Classification; JIS Z 3211 Covered electrodes for mild steel, high tensile strength steel and low temperature service steel

definition_en: Granular mineral flux fed around the wire in submerged arc welding that covers the arc and weld pool, shields and refines the molten metal and forms slag; classified with the wire it is used with.
term_ja: サブマージアーク溶接用フラックス
variants_ja: サブマージアークフラックス
term_es: fundente para soldadura por arco sumergido
ng_note: 「助焊剂」は中国語ではんだ付け用のフラックスを指し、サブマージアーク溶接の粒状フラックスには使わない。
source_ref: ISO 14174 Welding consumables — Fluxes for submerged arc welding and electroslag welding — Classification; JIS Z 3352:2017 サブマージアーク溶接及びエレクトロスラグ溶接用フラックス; ISO 14174:2019 Welding consumables — Fluxes for submerged arc welding and electroslag welding — Classification

definition_en: Junction where two or more members are, or are to be, joined by welding, brazing or another joining method, defined by the geometric relation of the members (butt, T, lap, corner, edge).
ng_note: 「関節」（中国語「关节」、韓国語「관절」、ドイツ語「Gelenk」、スペイン語「articulación」）は生体や機構の関節・ヒンジの意味で、部材を接合する継手を指さない。
source_ref: AWS A3.0M/A3.0 (Standard Welding Terms and Definitions)

definition_en: Weld of approximately triangular cross-section that joins two surfaces meeting at an angle, as in T, lap and corner joints.
ng_note: 「圆角焊」（中国語）は角に丸み（R）を付ける意味の直訳で、溶接継手のすみ肉には「角焊缝」を使う。
source_ref: ISO 2553 (Welding and allied processes — Symbolic representation on drawings — Welded joints)

definition_en: Joint preparation in which the plate edges are left square, without bevelling, and placed with or without a gap for a butt weld.
source_ref: AWS A3.0M/A3.0 (Standard Welding Terms and Definitions)

definition_en: Orientation of a weld and of the welding direction relative to gravity, such as flat, horizontal, vertical or overhead, defined in ISO 6947 by angles of slope and rotation.
ng_note: 「溶接位置」（日本語）、「용접 위치」（韓国語）は溶接する場所・位置座標の意味になり、重力方向に対する溶接の向きを表さない。日本語・韓国語では「溶接姿勢」「용접 자세」を使う。
source_ref: ISO 6947 (Welding and allied processes — Welding positions); JIS Z 3011:2014 溶接姿勢－傾斜角及び回転角による定義

definition_en: All metal that was melted and solidified during welding, consisting of melted filler metal and melted base metal in proportions set by dilution.
ng_note: 「溶着金属」（日本語）、「熔敷金属」（中国語）、「용착 금속」「용착금속」（韓国語）は溶加材から移行した金属（deposited metal）の意味で、母材の溶融分を含む溶接金属とは別概念。
source_ref: JIS Z 3001-1 (Welding and allied processes — Vocabulary — Part 1: General)

definition_en: Region of a welded joint made up of the weld metal and the heat-affected zone, as distinct from the unaffected parent metal.
source_ref: ISO 17659 (Welding — Multilingual terms for welded joints with illustrations)

definition_en: Ability of a steel to form martensite to a given depth on quenching from the austenitic range, governed by its carbon and alloy content; in welding it indicates how readily the heat-affected zone hardens and becomes prone to cold cracking.
ng_note: 「淬硬性」（中国語）、「Aufhärtbarkeit」（ドイツ語）は焼入れで到達できる最高硬さ（主に炭素量で決まる）を指し、マルテンサイトが生じる深さを表す焼入れ性とは別の性質。
source_ref: J. C. Lippold, Welding Metallurgy and Weldability (Wiley, 2015)

definition_en: Heat treatment of stainless steels and nickel or aluminum alloys at high temperature to dissolve carbides or other precipitates, followed by rapid cooling to keep them in solution; used to restore weld zone corrosion resistance.
variants_ja: 固溶化処理;溶体化処理
ng_note: 「solution」は固溶体の意味。日本語「溶液焼鈍」、中国語「溶液退火」は「溶液（液体）」と取り違えた直訳。
source_ref: J. C. Lippold, D. J. Kotecki, Welding Metallurgy and Weldability of Stainless Steels (Wiley, 2005)

definition_en: Planar discontinuity lying parallel to the surface inside rolled plate, originating from inclusions or pipe in the ingot and not caused by welding, though it can open up at weld edges.
ng_note: 「積層」（日本語）、「层压」（中国語）、「적층」（韓国語）、「Laminierung」（ドイツ語）は板やフィルムを重ね合わせる積層加工の語で、圧延鋼板の内部に板面と平行に生じる層状のきず（ラミネーション）を指さない。
source_ref: AWS B1.11M/B1.11 Guide for the Visual Examination of Welds

definition_en: Particle of a foreign metal, such as tungsten or copper, trapped in the weld metal.
source_ref: ISO 6520-1 Welding and allied processes — Classification of geometric imperfections in metallic materials — Part 1: Fusion welding; JIS Z 3001-4:2013 溶接用語－第4部：溶接不完全部

definition_en: Imperfection in which the actual penetration of a weld is less than the specified penetration, typically leaving part of the root or joint faces unfused; ISO 6520-1 reference number 402.
variants_ja: 溶込み不良;不完全溶込み
ng_note: 「融合不良」（日本語）、「未熔合」（中国語）、「융합 불량」「융합불량」（韓国語）、「Bindefehler」（ドイツ語）、「falta de fusión」（スペイン語）は溶接金属が母材や前パスと融け合っていない融合不良（lack of fusion）の語で、溶込みが規定に達しない溶込不良とは別の不完全部。
source_ref: ISO 6520-1 Welding and allied processes — Classification of geometric imperfections in metallic materials — Part 1: Fusion welding; AWS A3.0M/A3.0 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

definition_en: Notch-like depression at the weld toe where the arc has melted away base metal that the deposit did not replace, reducing the section and raising stress.
ng_note: 「底切」（中国語）はエッチングや機械加工のアンダーカット、「Hinterschnitt」（ドイツ語）は成形品・機械加工の逆勾配形状を指し、溶接止端の溶け込み溝には使わない。
source_ref: ISO 6520-1 Welding and allied processes — Classification of geometric imperfections in metallic materials — Part 1: Fusion welding

definition_en: Portion machined or cut from a test piece or test weld to a prescribed shape and size for one destructive test, such as a tensile, bend, impact or macro test.
ng_note: 「試験材」（日本語）、「시험재」（韓国語）、「Prüfstück」（ドイツ語）、「pieza de ensayo」（スペイン語）は試験片を採取する前の溶接試験材（test piece）を指し、規格上 test specimen とは区別される。
source_ref: ISO 15614-1 Specification and qualification of welding procedures for metallic materials — Welding procedure test — Part 1: Arc and gas welding of steels and arc welding of nickel and nickel alloys; JIS Z 3001-1:2018 溶接用語－第1部：一般

definition_en: Adjustable time window on the A-scan of an ultrasonic instrument within which echoes are monitored for amplitude or transit time, for example to trigger an alarm or record the signal.
ng_note: 「Tor」（ドイツ語）は門・扉、「栅极」（中国語）はトランジスタや電子銃のグリッド電極を指し、超音波探傷器のゲートには使わない。
source_ref: ISO 5577 Non-destructive testing — Ultrasonic testing — Vocabulary

definition_en: Penetrant containing a fluorescent dye that is inspected under UV-A light in a darkened area, giving higher sensitivity than a color contrast penetrant.
source_ref: ISO 3452-1 Non-destructive testing — Penetrant testing — Part 1: General principles; JIS Z 2300 (非破壊試験用語)

definition_en: Any condition of a welding procedure, such as process, joint design, base and filler metal, position, preheat, PWHT, gas and electrical characteristics, that is recorded in a WPS or PQR and classed as essential, supplementary essential or nonessential.
source_ref: AWS B2.1/B2.1M Specification for Welding Procedure and Performance Qualification

definition_en: Person who sets up, monitors and adjusts mechanized or automatic welding equipment during welding, qualified under ISO 14732 rather than as a manual welder under ISO 9606.
ng_note: 「焊工」（中国語）、「Schweißer」（ドイツ語）、「soldador」（スペイン語）は手溶接を行う溶接技能者（welder, ISO 9606）を指し、機械・自動溶接装置を操作する溶接オペレータ（ISO 14732）とは資格が異なる。
source_ref: ISO 14732:2013 Welding personnel — Qualification testing of welding operators and weld setters for mechanized and automatic welding of metallic materials

definition_en: Shape of the path traced by the torch as it oscillates across the weld line, such as zigzag, triangular, circular or crescent, chosen in the robot's weaving settings.
term_ja: ウィービングパターン
ng_note: 「编织图案」（中国語）、「Webmuster」（ドイツ語）、「patrón de tejido」（スペイン語）は織物の織り柄の意味で、溶接トーチの揺動パターンには使わない。
source_ref: J. N. Pires, A. Loureiro, G. Bölmsjo, Welding Robots: Technology, System Issues and Application, Springer (2006); Yaskawa Motoman — arc welding robot systems, public product documentation; Norrish, Advanced Welding Processes, Woodhead Publishing

definition_en: Lateral distance of the torch oscillation from the weld line during weaving, set as a length in the weaving conditions of a welding robot or oscillator.
ng_note: 「编织幅度」は中国語で織物の編み（weaving）の直訳で、溶接トーチの揺動（摆动）には使わない。
source_ref: J. N. Pires, A. Loureiro, G. Bölmsjo, Welding Robots: Technology, System Issues and Application, Springer (2006); JIS Z 3001-7:2018 4.3.2; Yaskawa Motoman — arc welding robot systems, public product documentation

definition_en: Seam-tracking sensor that uses the change in welding current or voltage as the torch weaves across the groove to detect the joint position and correct the robot path, without a separate sensor head.
source_ref: JIS Z 3001-1:2018 溶接用語—第1部：一般; Daihen (OTC) — welding robot systems, public catalog

definition_en: Boundary surface between the adhesive layer and an adherend in a bonded joint, where adhesion forces act and where adhesive failure occurs.
ng_note: 「インターフェース」（中国語「接口」、韓国語「인터페이스」、ドイツ語「Schnittstelle」）はソフトウェア・電気機器の接続部の意味で、接着剤と被着材の境界面を指さない。
source_ref: EN 923 Adhesives — Terms and definitions

definition_en: Exposure of adhesive-bonded test joints to set laboratory conditions of heat, humidity, salt spray or immersion for a defined time before mechanical testing, to assess durability.
variants_ja: 老化試験;エージング試験
ng_note: 「時効試験」（日本語）・「时效试验」（中国語）・「시효 시험」（韓国語）は鋼などの金属の時効（ひずみ時効など）を調べる試験で、接着継手の環境暴露による劣化試験とは別概念。
source_ref: ISO 9142 Adhesives — Guide to the selection of standard laboratory ageing conditions for testing bonded joints

definition_en: Heat load on a worker from the combination of hot air, radiant heat (for example from preheated parts or the arc), humidity, work rate and protective clothing, assessed with indices such as WBGT.
ng_note: 「熱応力」（日本語）、「热应力」（中国語）、「열응력」（韓国語）、「Wärmespannung」（ドイツ語）、「tensión térmica」（スペイン語）は材料内部の温度差による応力（thermal stress）で、作業者の暑熱負荷には使わない。
source_ref: ISO 7243 Ergonomics of the thermal environment — Assessment of heat stress using the WBGT (wet bulb globe temperature) index

definition_en: Air-purifying respirator that removes airborne particles such as welding fume through a filter, either with replaceable filters on a facepiece or as a filtering facepiece.
ng_note: 日本語の「防毒マスク」、中国語の「防毒面具」、韓国語の「방독 마스크」は吸収缶で有害ガスを除去するマスクを指し、溶接ヒュームなどの粒子をろ過する防じんマスクとは別の保護具。
source_ref: JIS T 8151 防じんマスク; 42 CFR Part 84 Approval of Respiratory Protective Devices
